translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content.text: Man̈xa in gana pitzan in. Ol vac' checlaj in yaelal tic, ol in lolon yed' in c'ac'alc'olal.
Sval d'a Dios, man̈ ton̈ejoc tzac'och in mul d'a vib'an̈, al d'ayin b'aj ix och in mul chi'.
Ina a ach in a b'onac, ¿tom vach' tzab'i tzin a chaccaneli? Chuc tz'alji d'ayin, axo yed' tas sna eb' chuc spensar tzach ochi.
¿Tom lajan ilan icha quilan a on̈ anima on̈ tic?
¿Tom lajan a q'uinal icha jab' quic a on̈ chamelb'a anima on̈ tic?
Yuj chi' ¿tas yuj tza say valec' in mul yed' in paltail?
Vach'chom ojtac to malaj in mul, malaj junoc mach syal in scolanel d'a yol a c'ab'.
A ach val ix in a b'o'o, axo ticnaic tza nib'ej tzin a sateli.
Nacoti to d'a lum luum ix in a b'o'o, axo ticnaic, tzin ac'anxicanoch pococal.
Ix a b'o in nivanil tic icha tz'aj sb'o noc' queso ayic spajb'i noc' lech.
A ach ix ac' syamlaj sb'a in b'aquil yed' in ch'an̈al. Ix ac'anoch in b'ac'chil yed' in tz'umal d'a spatic.
Ix ac' in q'uinal, ix in a xajanani. Ix in a tan̈vej, yuj chi' pitzan in.
Palta axo ticnaic jun, snachajel vuuj to ay tas c'ub'eltac tza na' d'a in patic.
Van in ilani tato tz'och in mul, max in ac' nivanc'olal jab'oc yuj in mul chi'.
Tato ay in mul, ob'iltac in. Tato malaj in mul, palta max yal voch d'a ichan̈ d'a junc'olal, yujto tzin q'uixvi, tzin naancot in yaelal.
Tato svic'chaan̈ in b'a, satub'tac am tzutej in a sataneli. Icham syutej noc' choj spechan junoc noc' yic schi'a, icha chi' am tzin utej.
Tza say juntzan̈ testigo d'a in patic. Tzac' val cot oval d'ayin, icha scot n̈ilnaj eb' soldado yac'an oval.
¿Tas yuj in a chanac aljoc? Comonoc ayic manto in aljoc ix in chamcani, yic malaj mach iljinac in.
Comonoc ayic valjinac d'a in nun, vic'chajnacb'at d'a campusante, ichato malaj mach checlajnac.
Yacb'an to jab'n̈ej in q'uinal tic, eloc d'a a c'ol tzac'an jab'oc in junc'olal. Eloc d'a a c'ol tzac'an jab'oc in tzalajc'olal,
yic manto in b'at d'a chamub' d'a scal q'uic'alq'uinal b'aj maxtzac yal in paxta. A d'a jun lugar chi', veventac yilji, q'uic'alq'uinal xon̈ej, man̈xalaj jab'oc saquilq'uinal, xchi vin̈aj Job chi'.

footnotes.text: -22 A d'a tic syac' b'inaj b'aj sc'ochcan eb' chamnac vin̈aj Job.
